svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 02/12 The Arboretum (Rare)
svg.desc: A long, slow waterway lined with oaks. Walk it early and the geese have the place to themselves. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
